entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I received yesterday. The bike I ordered has a cracked frame. I'm really disappointed.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that you received a bike with a cracked frame. That's definitely not the VeloFit experience we want you to have. I understand how frustrating that must be.
Yeah, and to make things worse, the front wheel seems to be wobbly wheel. I suspect there may have been some shipping damage.

I sincerely apologize for the condition your bike arrived in. It sounds like it definitely suffered some shipping damage. We'll take care of this right away. To make things right, I'm going to process a full refund for the bike. You won't have to pay anything.

Absolutely. And of course, we'll arrange for the bike to be returned to us at no cost to you. I'll email you a free label that you can print out and attach to the original packaging. Just let me know when it's ready for pickup and we'll schedule a courier.
Wow, that's fantastic customer service. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome! I'm happy we could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
Our pleasure! Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
